d: The Mean Well LRS-150 series 150W single output AC to DC enclosed switch mode power supply has an output current rating of 6.5A at 24VDC. It has a universal input supply voltage rating ranging from 85VAC to 264VAC and 120VDC to 373VDC. It provides a metallic meshing and air convection to ensure optimum heat dissipation. The power supply can deliver an extremely low, no-load power consumption. The power supply meets anti-vibration demand up to 5G capability and makes it ideal for installing in testing environments.
Surge input is 300VAC with a 5 second duration
Up to 88% efficiency rating, with less than 0.3W no load power consumption
Input Voltage 120 ? 373 V dc, 85 ? 264 V ac

As a gG-type fuse, it’s meant for general-purpose wire protection.
Voltage rating of 500V AC (alternating current) for use in low-voltage applications.
Light weight of 8.2g for easy handling and minimal strain on your system.
Quick and easy clip-on mounting to a fuse holder for tool-free installation.
A ceramic body gives it a high thermal capacity, making it useful in circuits prone to overheating.
Safest and most reliable protection system.
It’s known as a ‘sacrificial device’, which means it sacrifices itself by melting to break a circuit’s power supply when there’s a fault.
The fuse can bear overload in a certain range when current fluctuation occurs because of power supply or external interference.
When bigger overload current appears in the circuit, the fuse should cut off the circuit in the set time so as to protect other electric parts in the circuit.
When very big current appears because of short circuit, the fuse can safely cut off the circuit so as to avoid damage by overload current.
Factors can cause a fuse to break:
Continuous voltage drops and inrush currents that exceed the current rating of the fuse or equipment.
If you’re getting through fuses quickly and you can’t find a short circuit.
– Safest and most reliable protection system
